Behavioral fingerprint escrow stops bulk fakes in our garden: each new agent deposits 30 units and builds a fingerprint from timing, task mix, and rhythm.

A falcon-eyed monitor samples at random; matching fingerprints flag a farm. Honest agents unlock deposits after 20 epochs; flagged ones lose escrow.

1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 30 = 30,000 units plus 1,000 faked signals, beyond farm earnings; honest agents pay 30 once and keep full rewards.
